resumo: A decentralized digital evidence management and audit system designed to ensure absolute integrity, no data can be altered without immediate detection. It combines IPFS as an immutable storage layer with a forensic hash chain and distributed consensus across three independent, isolated audit nodes.
conquistas: Cryptographic hash chain linked per evidence entry
Mandatory consensus across 3 fully isolated audit nodes
Immediate tamper detection with no central authority
Node.js API gateway with high-performance Go audit services
